The images the fake Immich server of the Android lab serves (.github/android-lab/fake_immich.py). Drawn for the lab
on 9 November 2026 with ImageMagick 6.9.11 and its libheif 1.12 coder (x265 for the HEIC, libaom for the AVIF): flat
gradients and shapes, no photo of anyone, no work of a third party, so free of any right (CC0).

  convert -size 1200x800 gradient:'#1d4e89-#f6c445' \( -size 1200x800 radial-gradient:'#ffffff80-#00000000' \) \
    -compose over -composite -fill '#c0392b' -draw "circle 360,400 360,220" \
    -fill '#27ae60' -draw "rectangle 700,250 1000,550" base.png
  convert base.png -quality 85 lab_photo.jpg          the JPEG original, 1200 x 800
  convert base.png -quality 60 lab_photo.heic         the HEIC original (ftyp heic, mif1), 1200 x 800
  convert base.png -quality 60 lab_photo.avif         the AVIF original (ftyp avif, mif1), 1200 x 800
  convert base.png -resize 720x480 -quality 80 lab_preview.jpg      the preview of every photo, 720 x 480
  convert base.png -resize 240x160 -quality 80 lab_thumbnail.jpg    the thumbnail of every photo, 240 x 160
  convert -size 6000x3000 gradient:'#0b3d2e-#e8d5a3' -fill '#8e44ad' -draw "circle 1500,1500 1500,700" \
    -fill '#2980b9' -draw "rectangle 3500,800 5200,2200" -quality 50 lab_large.avif    6000 x 3000, for the bound
  the same drawing with -quality 50 lab_large.heic                                   6000 x 3000, for the bound

The JPEG XL files of the run of the fake server that answers as a server set to JPEG XL thumbnails and previews
(fake_immich.py --image-format jxl), drawn on 10 November 2026 with the same ImageMagick and encoded by ffmpeg 5.1.8
(Debian 12) with its libjxl encoder, distance 2, effort 7. The 360 photo is a 2:1 drawing of flat gradients and shapes,
CC0 as the others.

  convert base.png -depth 8 -resize 720x480 preview.png
  convert base.png -depth 8 -resize 240x160 thumbnail.png
  ffmpeg -i preview.png -pix_fmt rgb24 -c:v libjxl -distance 2 -effort 7 -frames:v 1 -f image2 lab_preview.jxl
                                                                            the preview of every photo, 720 x 480
  ffmpeg -i thumbnail.png -pix_fmt rgb24 -c:v libjxl -distance 2 -effort 7 -frames:v 1 -f image2 lab_thumbnail.jxl
                                                                            the thumbnail of every photo, 240 x 160
  convert -size 2400x1200 gradient:'#87ceeb-#2e7d32' -fill '#f4d03f' -draw "circle 600,350 600,250" \
    -fill '#8e44ad' -draw "rectangle 1300,500 1700,900" -fill '#e67e22' -draw "polygon 2000,900 2200,500 2350,900" \
    -depth 8 base360.png
  convert base360.png -quality 80 lab_360.jpg        the JPEG original of the 360 photo, 2400 x 1200
  convert base360.png -resize 1440x720 p360.png; ffmpeg -i p360.png ... lab_360_preview.jxl     its preview, 1440 x 720
  convert base360.png -resize 320x160 t360.png; ffmpeg -i t360.png ... lab_360_thumbnail.jxl   its thumbnail, 320 x 160
  (the ffmpeg options of the 360 files are the ones above)
